clue-spell.description: You are too weak but you get a clue:{red}Use the spell when you meet Merlin.

wizards-kitchen.description: You are in the{blue}wizard's kitchen. There is a smell of toads and spices brewing. Merlin appears!

obstacle.useMessage: Merlin goes to replace his button.
obstacle.blocked: Oh dear! Merlin has caught you.

coach-house.description: You are in an{yellow}ancient{yellow}coach{yellow}house. Merlin's cloak, with a missing silver button, hangs on the wall. Something rustles.

small-room.description: You are in a{red}small{red}room.{white}The walls are covered with red silk. There are archways to the North and West.

grand-hall.description: You are in a{cyan}grand{cyan}hall.{white}There are doors in all directions. A{magenta}decorated{magenta}chamber{white}is to the South. Merlin's goblins are very close.

obstacle.useMessage: The goblins look worried!
obstacle.blocked: You fall into the goblin's trap.

obstacle.useMessage: Perhaps the goblins won't notice you!
obstacle.blocked: Merlin's goblins capture you.

dungeon.description: You are in an{yellow}enormous{yellow}dungeon.{white}An old, old woman guards the exit South, waiting to turn you into stone. There is a passage West.

obstacle.useMessage: The old woman is turned into stone.
obstacle.blocked: You become a stone statue.

merlins-lair.description: This is{blue}Merlin{blue}the{blue}wizard's{blue}lair.{white}The walls are purple and green. A cauldron boils. The wizard comes towards you!

obstacle.useMessage: He turns into a frog.
obstacle.blocked: You are turned into a frog.

courtyard.description: You are in a{yellow}sunny{yellow}courtyard{white}with rambling pink roses. To the North is a{cyan}drawbridge.{white}There is a{green}coach{green}house{white}to the East. Southwards is a{magenta}hall.

moat.description: You are on the North bank of a{magenta}moat.{white}Some guards are at the{cyan}toll{cyan}gate.{white}A path leads North through an archway.

obstacle.useMessage: The drawbridge lowers.
obstacle.blocked: The drawbridge is up.

forest-edge.description: You are at the edge of a{green}dense{green}forest{white}on a path running East to West. An owl hoots in the trees.

river-south-bank.description: You are on the South bank of a{blue}river.{white}A{green}forest{white}lies to the West. To the South, through a stone archway, a{yellow}golden{yellow}spire{white}is shining in the sun.

north.message: You cross over without any trouble.

obstacle.useMessage: The plank makes a bridge for you.
obstacle.blocked: You fall in but get out safely.

beautiful-chamber.description: You are in a{magenta}beautiful{magenta}chamber.{white}The floor is covered in black and white tiles and the walls are gold. A lonely flute is playing.

dark-tunnels.description: You are at a crossroads in the{blue}tunnels.{white}It is very dark.

obstacle.useMessage: It is lighter. You can hear music.
obstacle.blocked: You fall over in the dark.

clue-silver.description: You are lost but you find a clue:   {red}Give Merlin silver for his buttons.

dragon-cave.description: You stand in a{cyan}large{cyan}cave.{white}A{red}splendid{red}dragon{white}puffing fire stands in the entrance of the tunnel South. More tunnels lead West and North.

obstacle.useMessage: The dragon's fire turns to smoke.
obstacle.blocked: You are overcome by fire and smoke.

west.message: The dragon's fire does not harm you.

cave-entrance.description: You are at the entrance to a{cyan}cave{white}going East.{white}A foot-path leads West. Southwards a{blue}tunnel{white}goes underground.

obstacle.useMessage: You can see where you're going now!
obstacle.blocked: It's too dark down there.

obstacle.useMessage: You sweep away the leaves.
obstacle.blocked: A pile of leaves fills the entrance.

mountain-path.description: You are on a path running North to South. Thick{green}trees{white}are at the foot of a{cyan}mountain{white}to the North.

obstacle.useMessage: You cut down all the trees.
obstacle.blocked: The trees are too dense.

evergreen-glade.description: You are in an{green}evergreen{green}glade,{white}with{red}red{red}spotted{red}toadstools{white}growing in a ring. A path runs from East to West.

deep-river.description: To the South a{blue}deep{blue}river{white}is running swiftly. Paths lead North and East. A{yellow}golden{yellow}spire{white}can be seen to the South across the water.

obstacle.useMessage: The plank reaches to the other side.
obstacle.blocked: You are swept away by the current.

grassy-bank.description: You are standing at a cross-roads. On a{green}grassy{green}bank{white}a figure lies sleeping.
grassy-bank.firstVisitDescription: You wake up on a{green}grassy{green}bank{white}at a cross-roads. It is warm and the bees are humming. There is a feeling of magic and mystery all around you.

old-stone-wall.description: To the West is an{yellow}old{yellow}stone{yellow}wall{white}four metres tall. A winding track runs to the East.

obstacle.useMessage: The ladder leans against the wall.
obstacle.blocked: The wall is too high.

old-wall.description: An{yellow}old{yellow}wall{white}is to the East. North is a path which winds into the mist. A small, dark{blue}tunnel{white}goes West. To the South are some{green}trees.

obstacle.useMessage: That's better.
obstacle.blocked: You can't see.

obstacle.useMessage: The ladder reaches the top.
obstacle.blocked: The wall is much too tall.

rusty-gate.description: You are by an{red}old{red}rusty{red}gate.{white}Mist swirls around you. A path leads South.

obstacle.useMessage: The gate swings open with a creak.
obstacle.blocked: It is locked.

yellow-flowers.description: The ground is covered with{yellow}tiny{yellow}yellow{yellow}flowers.{white}South is a{red}rusty{red}gate.{white}An overgrown path leads North.

south.message: The gate closes slowly behind you.

obstacle.useMessage: The gate opens.
obstacle.blocked: It won't open.

mossy-steps.description: To the North some{green}mossy{green}steps{white}lead upwards. An overgrown path runs South. In the East you can see a{magenta}high{magenta}balcony.

obstacle.useMessage: The snake glides away silently.
obstacle.blocked: A coiled snake hisses at you.

east.message: The ladder slips and you fall.

obstacle.useMessage: The ladder is propped up ready.
obstacle.blocked: The balcony is too high to reach.

tower.description: You enter a tower. It is dark and musty inside. The way out is covered by an{blue}enormous{blue}stone.{white}A shiver runs down your spine.

obstacle.useMessage: The stone rolls aside.
obstacle.blocked: You are enclosed.

forest-witches.description: You are in the{green}forest.{white}Some rabbits warn you of some{magenta}witches{magenta}dancing{white}in the West.

obstacle.useMessage: The witches fly off to the moon.
obstacle.blocked: The witches catch you and tie you up.

forest-crossroads.description: You are at a crossroads in the{green}forest.{white}In the distance to the South you can see some smoke.

charcoal-hut.description: You are inside a{red}charcoal{red}burner's{red}hut.{white}His fire smoulders, but he is not there.

mountain.description: You are on a{cyan}mountain.{white}Some{yellow}treasure{white}lies to the East. A track leads South. A{blue}maze{white}lies to the North.

east.message: Oh dear! Merlin's trap is that way.

maze.description: You are inside the{blue}maze{white}at a crossroads. You can sense danger.

obstacle.useMessage: You swing over a deep hole.
obstacle.blocked: You slip down a deep, deep hole.

damp-tunnels.description: Tunnels lead West and North. The air is damp and stale.

trolls.description: There are passages to the East and North. Some{magenta}trolls{white}ask you to play a tune for them.

obstacle.useMessage: The trolls dance and let you pass.
obstacle.blocked: The trolls cast a spell on you.

treasure-room.description: You are in a{yellow}treasure{yellow}room.{white}There are doors to the South, West and East.

obstacle.useMessage: You pass safely over the hole.
obstacle.blocked: Oh dear! You fall into darkness.

giant.description: Tunnels lead South, West and East. A{magenta}hungry{magenta}looking{magenta}giant{white}is waiting in the West.

obstacle.useMessage: The way South is open.
obstacle.blocked: The way through is padlocked.

obstacle.useMessage: The giant smiles. You can pass.
obstacle.blocked: The giant turns you into a mouse.

oak-door.description: There is a tunnel to the East. An{green}old{green}oak{green}door{white}bars your way South. You can hear singing from behind it.

obstacle.useMessage: The door opens.
obstacle.blocked: The door is firmly locked.

clue-mask.description: You are lost but you find a clue:   {red}A{red}mask{red}hides you{red}from{red}goblins.

clue-ring.description: You are lost but you find a clue:   {red}A{red}ring helps to{red}move{red}a{red}stone.

clue-plank.description: You are lost but you find a clue:   {red}A{red}plank{red}makes a{red}bridge{red}for{red}you.

clue-rope.description: You are lost but you find a clue:   {red}Tie{red}goblins{red}up with rope if you can.
